nahhas-meani:1-1.t:
Among that is His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحاً مُّبِيناً﴾.
Qatāda related from Anas, who said: ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحاً مُّبِيناً لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ﴾ was revealed after the Prophet ﷺ returned from al-Ḥudaybiya. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A verse has been revealed to me that is dearer to me than the whole world," then he recited it. A man of the Muslims said: May it bring you joy and ease! This is for you, O Messenger of Allah; so what is for us? So Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, revealed ﴿لِيُدْخِلَ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ﴾ to the end of the verse.
Mujāhid said concerning His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحاً مُّبِيناً﴾: We have decreed for you a clear decree.
Sufyān said: ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ﴾: that is, what was in the Jāhiliyya; ﴿وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ﴾: he said: what was in Islam, of what you have not yet done.
Abū Jaʿfar said: Concerning His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He, ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحاً مُّبِيناً﴾ there are three views close to one another:
a- Among them is what has preceded: that it is the opening of al-Ḥudaybiya. Al-Ḥudaybiya is a well after which the place was named.
Abū Jaʿfar said: And I know of no one among the lexicographers who doubles the yāʾ in it. In its opening there was the greatest of signs, because the Prophet ﷺ, according to what is related, came to this well when its water had been drained; so he ﷺ rinsed his mouth and spat into it, and the water came forth until everyone who was with him drank. And between them [and the idolaters] there was nothing but an exchange of shots, until the opening came. This is one view.
b- And it is said the meaning is: ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحاً مُّبِيناً﴾ through avoiding the major sins, ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللهُ﴾ the minor sins.
c- And it is said: ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحاً مُّبِيناً﴾ through guidance to Islam.
These views are close to one another, and Mujāhid's view combines them, because the opening of al-Ḥudaybiya is a decree among the decrees of Allah and a guidance among His guidance, by which He guides whom He wills; and likewise the avoidance of major sins.
And something that strengthens it is related from Ibn ʿAbbās; he said: I did not know what the meaning of ﴿إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا﴾ was until the daughter of Mishraḥ said to me: May Allah judge (fataḥa) between me and you.
* And His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالحَقِّ﴾.

nahhas-meani:2-3.t:
Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطاً مُّسْتَقِيماً وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْراً عَزِيزاً﴾ [Verses 2 and 3].
That is, a help possessing might, with no abasement accompanying it.

nahhas-meani:4-4.t:
Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿هُوَ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوۤاْ إِيمَاناً مَّعَ إِيمَانِهِمْ﴾.
﴿السَّكِينَةُ﴾: that is, calm and tranquillity.
* And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾.
That is, everything in them indicates that they have a Creator, and that He is One.

nahhas-meani:5-6.t:
Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلأَنْهَارُ﴾.
That is, He opened for you through Islam and guidance by this.
And His saying, Glorified is He, also points to it: ﴿وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَاتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ﴾.
Because they thought that the Prophet ﷺ would not return. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ﴾: that is, destruction.
And it is read: «السُّوْءُ»; and the difference between them is that «السَّوْءَ» is the thing itself, and «السُّوْءُ» is the act.

nahhas-meani:8-8.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِداً وَمُبَشِّراً وَنَذِيراً﴾.
Qatāda said: That is, a witness over your community, ﴿وَمُبَشِّراً﴾ [bearing good tidings to] the doer of good among them, ﴿وَنَذِيراً﴾ [warning] the evildoer.
Abū Jaʿfar said: This is a good view, and this is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara, a circumstantial whose state comes about later).
Sībawayh reported: marartu bi-rajulin maʿahu ṣaqrun, ṣāʾidan bihi ghadan (I passed by a man with a falcon, [intending to be] hunting with it tomorrow).
So the meaning is: We have sent you, Our having decreed your witnessing on the Day of Resurrection. And on this basis you say: raʾaytu ʿAmran qāʾiman ghadan (I saw ʿAmr, [to be] standing tomorrow).

nahhas-meani:9-9.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿لِّتُؤْمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً﴾.
Shuʿba related from Abū Bishr, from ʿIkrima, concerning His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ﴾: he said: and fight alongside him with the sword.
Qatāda said: and help him.
And Juwaybir read: that is, and magnify him. «[Translator's note: the text has قرأ ("read"), though what follows is a gloss rather than a reading; قال ("said") seems intended.]»
And ʿĀṣim al-Jaḥdarī read ﴿وتَعْزُرُوهُ﴾.
Its origin in the language is from honouring and purifying; and from it is "al-taʿzīr", which is [a discretionary punishment] below the ḥadd (prescribed penalty).
And Muḥammad al-Yamānī read ﴿وَتُعَزِّزُوهُ﴾ with two dotted zāys. One says ʿazzazahu, i.e. he made him mighty and strengthened him; and from it is His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ﴾.
And it is possible that ﴿وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ﴾ refers to Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, alone, and it is possible that it refers to the Prophet ﷺ.
As for His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً﴾,
it cannot be except for Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He,
because its meaning must be either as Juwaybir said: and pray to Him;
or its meaning is: and glorify Him and declare Him free of imperfection.

nahhas-meani:10-10.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ﴾.
That is, your contracting the pledge of allegiance with them is a contract for Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He.
* Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾.
That is, the hand of Allah in reward.
And it is said: in fulfilment.
And it is said: in His favour upon them through guidance.
﴿فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ in obedience.
﴿فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ﴾: one says nakatha when someone breaks what he has bound himself to.

nahhas-meani:11-11.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَالُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا﴾.
Mujāhid said: They are the Bedouins of Medina, and Juhayna and Muzayna.
* Then He said, Exalted is He: ﴿شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَالُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا﴾: that is, we have no one to guard our wealth and look after our families.

nahhas-meani:15-15.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ﴾ [Verse 15].
Mujāhid said: The Prophet ﷺ called them to go out to Mecca, but they refused and said: How can we go out with him to a people who came to him and killed his Companions? Then when the Prophet ﷺ went out, and seized a group off guard and sent them away, they said ﴿ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ﴾.
* Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُواْ كَلاَمَ ٱللَّهِ﴾.
And it is, according to the view of Ibn Zayd, His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فَقُلْ لَنْ تَخْرُجُوا
مَعِيَ أَبَداً وَلَنْ تُقَاتِلُوا مَعِي عَدُوّاً﴾.

nahhas-meani:16-16.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُوْلِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ﴾.
Sufyān related from Shuʿba, from Jaʿfar ibn Iyās, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr — Sufyān said: I think from Ibn ʿAbbās — ﴿سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُوْلِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ﴾: he said: Hawāzin.
And ʿAṭāʾ said: They are Persia.
And al-Ḥasan said: Persia and Byzantium.
And among the soundest of what has been said about it is that they are "Banū Ḥanīfa", who were fought in the Ridda (apostasy wars); and this was among the things in the Qurʾān indicating the validity of the caliphate of Abū Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him.
And what shows you that is His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ﴾; so these are not among those from whom the jizya is taken.
* And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْاْ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُمْ مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَاباً أَلِيماً﴾.
That is, as you turned away [from going out] with the Prophet ﷺ.

nahhas-meani:17-17.t:
ʿUthmān ibn al-Mughīra said: I asked al-Ḥasan about His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلاَ عَلَى ٱلأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلاَ عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ ﴾.
He said: This is concerning jihad.

nahhas-meani:18-18.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿لَّقَدْ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ﴾.
Juwaybir said: They pledged allegiance on [the condition] that they would not flee.
And Qatāda said: They were one thousand four hundred, and the tree was a samura (acacia).
* And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحاً قَرِيباً﴾.
﴿فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: of sincerity.
﴿فَأنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: Qatāda said: patience and dignified composure.
﴿وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحاً قَرِيباً﴾: Ibn Abī Laylā said: Khaybar.

nahhas-meani:20-20.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ﴾.
His saying ﴿فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِ﴾: Mujāhid said: He means Khaybar.
* Then He said, Exalted is He: ﴿وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ﴾: because they had left their dependants behind, fearful for them; so Allah protected [them] from them, and restrained the hands of people from them.

nahhas-meani:21-21.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُواْ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيراً﴾.
Shuʿba related from Simāk al-Ḥanafī, who said: I heard Ibn ʿAbbās say concerning His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُواْ عَلَيْهَا﴾: They are the conquests that have been opened for you.
And Ibn Abī Laylā said: They are Persia and Byzantium.
And Mujāhid said: It is whatever will come afterwards until the Day of Resurrection.
And Qatāda said: It is the conquest of Mecca.

nahhas-meani:22-22.t:
Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَلَوْ قَاتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كفَرُواْ لَوَلَّوُاْ ٱلأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجِدُونَ وَلِيّاً وَلاَ نَصِيراً﴾.
Qatāda said: The disbelievers of Quraysh.
Abū Jaʿfar said: And if those of them who did not fight you had fought you, they would have been routed, because it is in the way (sunna) of Allah to help His allies.
Qatāda said — meaning concerning His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He, ﴿ثُمَّ لاَ يَجِدُونَ وَلِيّاً وَلاَ نَصِيراً﴾ —: and they will find for themselves no protector and no helper against Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He.

nahhas-meani:24-24.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾.
He restrained the hands of the idolaters from those whom the believers had left behind when they went out to al-Ḥudaybiya.
Qatāda said concerning His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ﴾: "A man from among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ called "Zunaym" looked out [over the hill], and the idolaters shot him with an arrow and killed him. So the Prophet ﷺ sent out horsemen, and they captured twelve riders and brought them to the Prophet ﷺ. He said to them: Do you have a covenant or a guarantee of protection? They said: No. So he released them." Then Allah, Exalted is He, revealed ﴿وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ﴾.
Qatāda said: He means al-Ḥudaybiya.

nahhas-meani:25-25.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفاً أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ﴾.
Qatāda said: ﴿وَٱلْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفاً﴾: detained.
* And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكمْ مِّنْهُمْ مَّعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ﴾.
﴿أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ﴾: that is, kill them; ﴿فَتُصِيبَكمْ مِّنْهُمْ مَّعَرَّةٌ﴾: that is, disgrace.
The idolaters would say: They killed the people of their own religion. And had you done so, Allah would [still] have admitted them into His mercy.
* And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿لَوْ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنْهُمْ عَذَاباً أَلِيماً﴾.
Mujāhid said: ﴿لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ﴾ by captivity and killing.

nahhas-meani:26-26.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ﴾.
ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, Ibn ʿUmar and Abū Hurayra said: ﴿كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ﴾: There is no god but Allah.
* Then He said, Exalted is He: ﴿وَكَانُوۤاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا﴾.
That is, Allah chose them for His religion.

nahhas-meani:27-27.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ آمِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لاَ تَخَافُونَ﴾.
Mujāhid said: The Prophet ﷺ saw [in a dream] as though he and his Companions had entered Mecca with their heads shaved.
And Qatāda said: It is a dream the Prophet ﷺ saw at al-Ḥudaybiya, as though they had entered Mecca with their heads shaved and [hair] shortened; they found the dream slow [in coming true], then they entered after that.
As for His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ﴾, there are several views on it:
a- Among them: that the meaning is: if I will, you shall enter in security.
b- And it is said: it is a report of what was said to the Prophet ﷺ.
c- And it is said: the servants were addressed according to what they ought to say, as the Exalted said ﴿وَلاَ تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إنِّي فَاعِلٌ ذَلِكَ غَداً إلاَّ أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللهُ﴾.
d- And it is said: the exception (istithnāʾ) concerns those of them who would die or be killed.
* And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَلِكَ فَتْحاً قَرِيباً﴾.
Mujāhid said: They returned from al-Ḥudaybiya, then Allah opened Khaybar to them.

nahhas-meani:29-29.t:
And His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعاً سُجَّداً يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلاً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَاناً سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ﴾.
Saʿīd ibn Jubayr said: That is the trace of the ablution water and the moist soil of the ground.
And ʿIkrima said: It is the trace of dust.
Ibn Wahb said: Mālik informed me concerning His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾: he said: It is what clings to the forehead of the dust of the ground. So this is one view.
And Mujāhid said: It is only humility and lowliness, and the hypocrite does not have this.
And al-Ḥasan said: A whiteness that will be on the face on the Day of Resurrection.
And ʿAṭiyya said: The place of the forehead will be whiter on the Day of Resurrection than the rest of the face.
And al-Ḍaḥḥāk said: This is on the Day of Resurrection; their prayer will appear on their faces.
And Shimr ibn ʿAṭiyya said: It is the puffiness of the face and its paleness from staying awake at night.
And Qatāda said: They were described by prayer, i.e. they are known by prayer.
* Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿ذَلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي ٱلتَّوْرَاةِ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي ٱلإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ﴾.
ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa related from Ibn ʿAbbās: ﴿مَثَلُهُمْ﴾ means their description ﴿فى التوراة والإِنجيل﴾, i.e. written in them both.
And Qatāda said: What preceded is their likeness in the Torah, and they have another likeness in the Gospel, namely ﴿كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ﴾.
Al-Ḍaḥḥāk said: They are two likenesses: the first in the Torah and the second in the Gospel.
And Mujāhid said: They are a single likeness; and the complete stop (al-tamām), according to Mujāhid's view, is at ﴿فِي ٱلإِنجِيلِ﴾.
* Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ﴾.
﴿كَزَرْعٍ﴾: that is, they are like a sown crop [Translator's note: i.e. khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject)].
﴿أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ﴾: Ḥumayd related from Anas, who said: its growth, its offshoots.
Abū ʿUbayda said: One says ashṭaʾa al-zarʿu when its offshoots come out.
Al-Farrāʾ said: The grain puts forth ten, seven or eight ears.
* Then He said, Exalted is He: ﴿فَآزَرَهُ﴾.
Mujāhid said: That is, it strengthened it and supported it.
And al-Ḍaḥḥāk said: They are the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ; they were few and became many, and were weak and became strong.
* Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ﴾.
[Sūq is] the plural of sāq (stalk). ﴿يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ﴾ is a similitude. ﴿لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ﴾: Qatāda said: that is, so that Muḥammad ﷺ and his Companions may enrage the disbelievers.
* Then He said, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْراً عَظِيماً﴾.
It is possible that "min" here is for explaining the genus (bayān al-jins), as the Exalted said: ﴿فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الأَوْثَانِ﴾.
And it is possible that it is partitive (li-l-tabʿīḍ), i.e. Allah has promised those of them who remained firm in faith forgiveness and a great reward.
